limitations: Only inquiry GET /api/ptr/case/query.json with fixed pageNo=0/pageSize=5000. No backend filtering, Get, trial, execute or update.
Two successful complete acquisitions of the same full outflow library must have equal totals and equal sorted retained-field contents; a failed read is not a stability retry.
Preserves the pinned case, baseline and monetary field whitelist. Other native fields are deliberately omitted, and changes to omitted fields do not establish retained-content instability.
Both complete scopes remain in custom query evidence. Empty, failed, duplicate, truncated or unstable refresh cannot replace the saved nonempty capture.
Exact local whole-string filters OR within a field and AND across fields; no wildcard, substring, comma splitting or coercion.

The verified native contract is a fixed page0/5000 full-library inquiry with top-level boolean success, resultDataList, exact page echoes, integer totalCount and unique native id. Two complete retained-content reads are required before output.
